solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       ROUND(AVG(weight_kg))::integer AS avg_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;
notes: Customer 5 averages exactly 1126.5 and customer 6 exactly 899.5. Half-up rounding gives 1127 and 900, so the tie rule shows up in the sample.
